headline: Properties will not get cheaper, but prices will rise more slowly
summary: Bulgaria ranks second in Europe for house price growth in the second quarter of 2026, at 15.5% year on year. Prices are expected to keep rising, though more slowly.
why: House price trends affect mortgage demand, bank lending and construction activity, which are important inputs for assessing a country's property and credit cycle.
